tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi gling bzhi gling phran jo mo gling gsum sogs kyi gnas bsrung rnams la gser skyems 'bul tshul srung ma dges pa'i mchod sprin dge'o// na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra dharma pā lā ya/ rigs kun khyab bdag mnyam med bka' drin can/ /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas bcas pa yis/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad la/ /gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod 'bul ci bsam stsol/ /dngos grub kun stsol gsang sngags gsar rnying gi /yi dam spyi dang khyad par 'phrin las lha/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gser skyems༞ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las drag po bdud 'dul sku/ /gur zhal la sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong mdzad thams cad la/ /gser skyems༞ /khyad par rgyal ba kun gyi bsti gnas mchog /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa yis/ /gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /legs skyongs srung ma'i dbang po drag shugs can/ /thugs kyis rgyal po chen po li byin har/ /chibs sna khrid pa'i mon bu pu tra dang / /'phrin las mgon po srog bdag tse'u dmar/ /gsang ba'i yum chen shin+ti ro zan ma/ /sprul pa'i blon po srog bdag bya ra ba/ /yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i/ /thugs kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gser skyems༞ /sku yi rgyal po mon bu pu ṭa che/ /gsang yum bdud mo ro langs dkar mo dang / /blon po bya khrid mig gcig 'khor bcas la/ /gser skyems༞ /yon tan rgyal po chen po shing bya can/ /gsang yum nag mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ /blon po bya rgod thang nag 'khor bcas la/ /gser skyems༞ /gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig che/ /gsang yum mdzes byed dmar mo pad+ma can/ /blon po rdo rje drags ldan 'khor bcas la/ /gser skyems༞

/'phrin las rgyal mo chen po dpe dkar che/ /gsang yum bdud gza' nag mo smin dkar ma/ /blon po pu ṭa nag po 'khor bcas la/ /gser skyems༞ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rgyal chen gyi/ /bka' nyan sha grol kyi grol 'dzin pa dang / /sdom po skyo sangs 'bag dang seng ge dang / /mon bu a tsa ra dang spre'u tshogs/ /bud med skyes pa dge slong sngags pa sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul snang srid lha srin la/ /gser skyems༞ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dam rjes dgongs la/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin chos srid dpal 'byor spel/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa thugs bskyed smon lam dang / /bod 'bangs sems can rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras/ /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa yi/ /snod bcud kun la srungs skyobs mel tshe mdzod/ /'jig rten khams 'dir mi mthun rgud tshogs zhi/ /bde skyid dpal 'byor rdzogs ldan dus ltar rgyas/ /skye dgu rnams kyi 'phral yun phan bde kun/ /'bad med lhun gyi grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyad par gnas 'dis dkon mchog rnam gsum dang / /sku gsung thugs rten ngo mtshar can rnams la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho spyi dang bye brag tu/ /mar me'i 'phreng ba khor mo yug tu mdzod/ /bsrung ma khyed rnams bsten cing sgrub pa yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /lhag bsam rnam dag rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las ni/ /gang bcol thogs med mdzod cig sa mā ya/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bha mastu/ sarba dza ga staṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi gnas srung rnams la gser skyems 'bul tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
